name: airbyte
desc: Open-source data movement for ELT pipelines and AI agents — from APIs, databases & files to warehouses, lakes, and AI applications. Both self-hosted and Cloud.

name: XActions
desc: ⚡ The Complete X/Twitter Automation Toolkit — Scrapers, MCP server for AI agents (Claude/GPT), CLI, browser scripts. No API fees. Open source. Unfollow people who don't follow back. Monitor real-time analytics. Auto follow, like, comment, scrape, without API. Follow Bot. Like bot. Grow your account automatically.

name: loopx
desc: Turn long-horizon goals into verifiable results. A local-first semantic control plane and research workbench for long-running agent teams, across sessions and runtimes.

name: mindroom
desc: AI agents that know you and your work, in a chat app anyone can use. Open source, any model, self-host or hosted.

name: Adelie
desc: A local-first multi-agent app development platform, built on PenguinHarness

name: hol-guard
desc: Open-source antivirus for AI agents: block risky tools, secret access, prompt injection, malicious packages, MCP servers, plugins, and skills at runtime.

name: octo-agent
desc: Open-source, single-binary, self-hosted AI agent — your models and data stay on your machine. A coding agent on par with Claude Code and a personal assistant lighter than OpenClaw, across eight interfaces (TUI, CLI, Web, desktop, IM, VS Code, Obsidian, Mobile), all in one MIT-licensed Go binary running on any model.

name: zhin
desc: AI-native TypeScript bot framework — one codebase for 20+ chat platforms (QQ, Discord, Telegram, Slack, WeChat…). Opt-in AI agent with MCP, tools & security policies. <10MB core.

name: walrus-memory
desc: A portable memory layer that makes AI agents reliable across apps and sessions. Persistent, verifiable, and fully under your control.
